item.title: Murph is funnier in group chats, and picks its moments
item.summary: In a group chat Murph now gives you a hard time the way a friend would: it plays along with your bits, has an answer for a creative excuse, and remembers what your group calls each other. Most of its messages are still just the count and the answer.
item.details: It never jokes about bodies, health, or anything you didn't say in the chat, and it doesn't keep reusing its own old jokes. Tell it a joke missed and it takes the note.
